source_note: Recovered from sequence_tabbar/frame_000.png, captured 2026-07-05 during tab-bar highlight calibration - promoted into the library on 2026-07-06. Image replaced 2026-10-11 with a live full-frame capture (ALL tab highlighted, Mortal Kombat II selected).
roi_reason: Title bar plus tab row (2026-10-11, re-captured live at 1920x1080). The tab row is what tells this screen apart from the per-game menus, which share the GAME LIBRARY title bar. title_check confirms the title and tab names.
match_distance_reason: 2026-10-12: with the game windowed at 1280x720 (upscaled to 1920x1080) this screen scored 25-28, just past the default 24, so it flipped between this entry and OCR fallback on every move. The nearest look-alike, a game's own menu under the same GAME LIBRARY title, scores 51-58; title_check still has to pass.
notes: Tab bar for filtering the game library. Confirmed live (2026-07-05) that all three tabs use the same cyan/gold highlight scheme as list menus, so find_highlighted_text_from_entry against the stored bboxes below should correctly announce which tab is selected as the user navigates. 2026-10-11: added HANDHELD (cut off in the old capture) and a live region for the selected game's name and year at the bottom centre.
